title: Zesty Silky Vietnamese Shrimp Goi Cuon
description: A kid-friendly Vietnamese dish featuring shrimp and vegetables wrapped in silky rice paper, flavored with paprika and a hint of flambe, suitable for shojin-friendly diets
instructions: Fill a large bowl with warm water to soak the rice paper wrappers
In a separate bowl, mix together the shrimp, paprika, and a pinch of salt
Add the julienned carrots, sliced cucumber, and chopped mint leaves to the bowl with the shrimp
Stir in the cooked vermicelli noodles and flambe sauce
Soak a rice paper wrapper in the warm water for about 10 seconds
Place about 1/4 cup of the shrimp and vegetable mixture onto the center of the wrapper
Fold the bottom half of the wrapper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling
Serve the goi cuon immediately, garnished with additional mint leaves if desired
